measurement_object.name: ACSB-CONTINGENCY-BOUNDARY-UPDATE-OBJECT-001A
measurement_object.purpose: Measure whether a future candidate updates self/external boundary state from action-conditioned contingency evidence and uses that update in a non-identical future probe.
measurement_object.state_definition_summary: Serialized bounded state with prior controllable versus external boundary belief, action-effect contingency evidence, no-action/external comparison evidence, uncertainty, update history, current boundary state before probe, state version/hash, and non-answer-bearing episode/context identifiers.
measurement_object.observation_definition_summary: Legal observations include current environment features, previous action, observed effect after action, observed effect after no-action or external event, local context features, non-answer-bearing intervention markers, and non-sufficient time/order information.
measurement_object.intervention_definition_summary: Real action-effect boundary changes such as mapping swaps, external-only mimic effects, removed action control with similar effect statistics, decoy effects, no-action counterfactual observations, and delayed future behavior probes.
measurement_object.measured_future_behavior_state_output_su: Future boundary assignment update plus heldout probe action/withholding/output and a compact self-caused/external-only/decoy/unresolved token derived from the same legal behavior path.
measurement_object.evaluator_hidden_target_boundary: Targets may be computed from hidden environment generation state but must never appear in legal candidate, baseline, ablation, replay, or leakage-scanner inputs.
